title: PolicyMediator: Multi-Regional Policy Learning through Mediation Agents with Evolving Skills in OPC Ecosystems
abstract: arXiv:2610.35997v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: One-person companies (OPCs) are emerging enterprises operated by individual entrepreneurs through digital platforms and LLM-based AI agents. These highly skilled entrepreneurs are characterized by being digital nomads, with limited reliance on local ecosystems. Governments in China use distinct regional support policies to attract mobile OPCs, turning local support into a cross-regional coordination problem. OPCs compare regions to maximize their own utility, but imperfect policy perceptions may cause them to reject otherwise suitable locations. Existing policy-learning methods optimize resources under fixed perceptions, while consensus-formation methods aggregate views without feeding cognitive changes back into policy learning. This disconnect produces mismatched location choices and inefficient regional policy adjustment. translated_title: PolicyMediator：基于具备演化技能的中介智能体实现OPC生态系统中的多区域政策学习
translated_abstract: 一人公司是由个体创业者通过数字平台和基于大语言模型（LLM）的AI智能体运营的新兴企业。这些高技能创业者以数字游民为特征，对本地生态系统依赖有限。中国各地方政府采用差异化的区域扶持政策来吸引流动的OPC，这使得本地扶持转变为一个跨区域协调问题。OPC会比较不同区域以最大化自身效用，但不完善的政策认知可能导致其拒绝原本合适的落户地点。现有政策学习方法在固定认知下优化资源配置，而共识形成方法仅聚合各方观点，并未将认知变化反馈到政策学习中。这种脱节导致了错配的选址决策和低效的区域政策调整。我们提出PolicyMediator——一个认知约束下的领导者-多追随者Stackelberg框架，具有双边……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出认知约束下的领导者-多追随者Stackelberg框架PolicyMediator，通过技能不断演化的中介智能体将OPC的认知变化反馈与多区域政策学习形成闭环，解决数字游民式一人公司跨区域选址错配与政策调整低效的问题。
